prompt: At night outside a vast automated distribution warehouse, its whole side open and blazing with white light, robot arms and conveyors working inside with not one person among them: a crowd of hundreds of people in coats stand pressed against the tall chain-link fence in the dark, looking in. Winter night in a near-future Britain, the streetlights dead, lit only by braziers, camping lanterns and the glow of the city's towers; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
